script.title: AT THE CONFERENCE
script.story_hook: A mom visits her child's teacher after class.
script.intro_zh: 下課後，一位媽媽來見孩子的老師。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a parent meets her child's teacher. Listen for meeting small talk.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天一位家長和孩子老師面談。留意開場閒聊與提問說法。
script.outro: A clear plan, a calmer home. See you soon!
script.outro_zh: 計畫清楚了，家裡也安心了。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each conference phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀座談常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her late thirties with shoulder-length wavy brown hair held back by a thin headband, wearing a denim jacket over a striped long-sleeve top, dark jeans and brown boots, average build
script.char_b_description: a young man in his twenties with short neat black hair and wire-rim glasses, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan over a white shirt, navy chinos and brown shoes, warm smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! You must be Mr. Alvarez?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！您一定是 Alvarez 老師吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's me. Welcome, Mrs. Chen!
dialogue.zh: 對，就是我。歡迎您，陳太太！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call me Grace. This room is lovely.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl mi ɡɹes ðɪs ɹum ɪz ˈlʌvli/
dialogue.zh: 叫我 Grace 就好。這教室真漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Grace. Please, have a seat.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，Grace。請坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've been wanting to ask about reading.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv bɪn ˈwɑɾɪŋ tə æsk əˈbaʊt ˈɹidɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我一直想問閱讀的情況。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great topic. Lucy's doing well there.
dialogue.zh: 問得好。Lucy 的閱讀不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? At home she only reads comics.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli æt hoʊm ʃi ˈonli ɹidz ˈkɑmɪks/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？她在家只看連環漫畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comics count! Pictures are text too.
dialogue.zh: 漫畫也算數！圖畫也是文字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that makes me feel better.
dialogue.zh: 噢，這樣我就放心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's her reading list from class.
dialogue.zh: 這是她在班上的閱讀清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Level P? What does that mean?
dialogue.zh: P級？那是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She reads chapter books with some help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɹidz ˈtʃæptɚ bʊks wɪθ sʌm hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 她讀章節書，還需要一點幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With help. Okay... who helps her?
dialogue.zh: 需要幫忙。好…是誰幫她？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her group. Three friends, one table.
dialogue.zh: 她的小組。三個朋友，一張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice small group. Does she talk much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪs smɑl ˈɡɹup dʌz ʃi ˈtɔk ˈmʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 小組真好。她在課堂上愛說話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only about books. Math class? Silent.
dialogue.zh: 只聊書。上數學課就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! That sounds like my kid.
dialogue.zh: 哈！聽起來就像我家的孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, homework habits — how are they?
dialogue.zh: 那作業習慣呢？表現如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, a nightly battle, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，每晚都像打仗。抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No shame. Many families feel that way.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʃeɪm ˈmɛni ˈfæməliz fil ðæt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不用不好意思。很多家庭都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's the math that makes her cry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə ˈmæθ ðæt ˈmeɪks hɜɹ ˈkɹaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一做數學她就掉眼淚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. How long does homework take?
dialogue.zh: 好。作業都要寫多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An hour. Sometimes closer to two.
dialogue.zh: 一個小時。有時快兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, that's too long for third grade.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðæts tu ˈlɔŋ fɚ ˈθɜɹd ˈɡɹeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哇，對三年級來說太久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right? We fight over the numbers.
dialogue.zh: 是吧？我們老為了數字吵架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's try a new plan, deal?
dialogue.zh: 我們試試新計畫，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. What do you have in mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdil wʌt du ju hæv ɪn ˈmaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 好。你有什麼想法？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes max, math first.
dialogue.zh: 數學先寫，最多二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then she can stop at twenty minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi kæn stɑp æt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 那二十分鐘一到就能停？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Homework can wait. Reading can't.
dialogue.zh: 能。作業可以等，閱讀不能等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? You allow unfinished homework?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？作業沒寫完也可以？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For practice, yes. It's not graded.
dialogue.zh: 練習作業可以。那不算分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That changes everything. Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 那局面就完全不同了。謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And ten minutes of reading nightly.
dialogue.zh: 再加一項：每晚十分鐘閱讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Comics count for that too?
dialogue.zh: 漫畫也能算那十分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Reading is her superpower.
dialogue.zh: 當然。閱讀是她的超能力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her superpower? You really think so?
dialogue.zh: 超能力？你真的這樣認為嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do. Use it in math, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈdu ˈjuz ɪt ɪn ˈmæθ tu/
dialogue.zh: 真的。把它用在數學上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In math? How does that work?
dialogue.zh: 數學？怎麼個用法？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have her read word problems aloud.
dialogue.zh: 讓她把應用題大聲讀出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! Stories help her understand them.
dialogue.zh: 噢！故事能幫她理解題目。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Math words are just stories.
dialogue.zh: 就是說啊。數學題就是小故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm writing that down, seriously.
dialogue.zh: 這一句我要記下來，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do. Now, one library note.
dialogue.zh: 請便。對了，一件圖書館的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The library? What about it?
dialogue.zh: 圖書館？怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's closed Fridays, starting this month.
dialogue.zh: 這個月起，週五閉館。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no! Her books are due Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ hɜɹ bʊks ɑɹ dju ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不！她的書正週五要還。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them Monday — no late fees.
dialogue.zh: 週一再帶來就好。不會罰款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. And... does she have friends?
dialogue.zh: 好險。還有…她在學校有朋友嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two best friends — Maya and Anna.
dialogue.zh: 有兩個最要好的：Maya 和 Anna。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maya's the loud one, right?
dialogue.zh: Maya 是那個很大聲的，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! The fun loud one. Good trio.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə fʌn laʊd wʌn ɡʊd ˈtɹioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！是開心果那種。三個人很合得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a weight off my mind.
dialogue.zh: 這下我心裡的石頭放下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How are things at home these days?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɑɹ ˈθɪŋz æt ˈhoʊm ðiz ˈdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這陣子家裡情況怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Busy. We both work till eight.
dialogue.zh: 很忙碌。我們兩人都工作到晚上八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then mornings may suit her better.
dialogue.zh: 那早上可能更適合她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning homework? I never thought of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ˈhoʊmˌwɜɹk aɪ ˈnɛvɚ θɔt ʌv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 早上寫作業？我從沒想過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some kids come early at seven twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm kɪdz kʌm ˈɜɹli æt ˈsɛvən ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 有些孩子七點二十就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven twenty? And a teacher is there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈtwɛnti ænd ə ˈtitʃɚ ɪz ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 七點二十？那時候會有老師嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — I'll run it. See you Monday!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl ɹʌn ɪt si ju ˈmʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 會，那個時段我值班。週一再見！

script.youtube_title_en: "Homework Can Wait" — A Parent-Teacher Conference About Reading and Routine
script.youtube_description:
60句親師座談聽力練習：孩子在家只愛漫畫、一寫數學就哭，該怎麼跟老師開口？

這一集跟著一位媽媽坐進教室，和老師聊閱讀等級、小組共讀、作業拉鋸、圖書館逾期，還有怎麼把孩子的強項變成方法。

你會聽到：
- 座談會的開場問候與閒聊
- 談閱讀程度與上課狀況的說法
- 討論作業習慣與新計畫的句型
- 借書逾期、早到自習的應對

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of parent-teacher conference listening practice: a worried mom asks why her daughter cries over math, and the teacher turns comics into a superpower.

You will hear how to talk about reading levels, homework habits, late library books, and a simple plan everyone can keep. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.
